image_description: A close-up shot of four audio cassette tapes arranged on a white surface. The primary subject is a black cassette in the foreground with its magnetic tape pulled out and tangled. Behind it are a red transparent cassette, a black/red cassette, and another black cassette in the background. The image features realistic lighting and shadows.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects clearly exhibit the standard aspect ratio and dimensions of compact cassettes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flat rectangular prism with rounded corners.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The main body shape is correct, with characteristic rounded corners visible on the black and red cassettes.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The two reel windows are present and correctly positioned on all visible cassettes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Two spools of magnetic tape visible through circular holes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Internal spool structures are visible through the windows, appearing mechanically plausible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular opening at bottom exposing tape for player head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bottom access door/slot is visible on the front-facing cassettes.

artifact_observations.location: Labels on all cassettes, specifically the black foreground cassette
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text mimics the visual pattern of writing but consists of non-existent characters and symbols, a common AI artifact.

artifact_observations.location: Tape ribbon extending from the black cassette
artifact_observations.reasoning: The magnetic tape ribbon lacks physical rigidity and structure; it merges into a black blob/loop without a clear start/end point or connection to the reels, defying physics.

artifact_observations.location: Surface of the black foreground cassette
artifact_observations.reasoning: The plastic surface has a waxy, overly smooth appearance lacking the fine molded grain typical of injection-molded plastic.

artifact_observations.location: Junction of the tape ribbon and the cassette body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The tape appears to melt out of the casing rather than exiting cleanly through the designated slot.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the objects are correctly identified as cassettes despite the artifacts.
To rigorously quantify the illegibility and gibberish nature of the text.
To analyze the connectivity of the loose tape and check for floating segments or fusion errors.
To assess the realism of the plastic textures and lighting consistency.

focus_areas: Legibility and semantic correctness of label text
Physical plausibility and continuity of the loose magnetic tape
Sharpness and correctness of molded plastic details (screw holes, tabs)
Boundary separation between the tape ribbon and the cassette body
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'tape ribbon' artifact. In real life, magnetic tape is thin and stiff; AI often renders it as a thick, melting black snake. Verify if the text is just blurry or actually hallucinated symbols. Check if the internal spools align logically with the amount of tape outside.
